narrative_prose: Kaio's boots scrambled for purchase on the trembling basalt as the Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea intensified, its deafening roar vibrating through his teeth like a swarm of angry bees. The air smelled of burned ozone and scorched metal, while blinding violet arcs illuminated the jagged peaks of liquid black iron surging toward the ridge outpost. He tasted the static on his tongue, his hands shaking slightly as he gripped the heavy expedition baton Hector had handed him, feeling the biting cold of the handle against his palm. With a sudden shift in the magnetic currents, a massive ferrofluid wave threatened to crest over the outpost, forcing Kaio to swiftly DEFEND the baton by wedging it under a reinforced brass bulkhead to avoid the crushing weight. He frantically waved a luminescent glow-stick to ATTRACT Ryn's attention through the static haze, knowing the survival of the outpost relied on passing the relay forward before the magnetic shear CONSUME their entire scaffolding.
